notes: Cache-first loading. A launch that finds this exact build on disk no longer touches the network at all: no 42 requests, no commit lookup, no CDN, no rate limit - just readfile and compile, which is milliseconds instead of a download. The loader decides with a manifest written only by a load that finished, so a half-written folder is never trusted; if a single file is missing it is fetched on its own, and if a cached file will not compile it is repaired from the network rather than failing every launch. Escape hatches: getgenv().AetherFresh (ignore the cache, bust queries) and getgenv().AetherNoCache (ignore the cache). A cached launch asks the updater to look once, off the load thread, so a new build is still noticed immediately - cache-first must never mean stuck.
